name: gb-live
tagline: Watches an X live stream and digests whatever actually changed
description: Watches a live broadcast on X and captures a screenshot whenever the picture changes, with a short Japanese note on what just happened. The notes build into an hourly digest that only arrives if something moved, so a quiet stream stays quiet. Nothing is posted publicly; the owner sees it first.
author: asura25ai
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
